remarks: Freshly painted, this centrally located upper level unit is strategically located close to I-95, Stamford train, and bus routes. Hardwood and wood laminate floors, updated kitchen with gas cooking, and sunlight. Rear deck for easy access from parking lot but not meant for storage. This rental comes with the priviledge of two parking spaces, laundry and storage in adjacent bldg, window unit a/c. Prospective tenant expected to have professional and past landlord references, three most recent paystubs, valid identification, complete RentSpree application from all adults over 18yrs. One month security deposit if over 62yrs old. Tenant responsible all utility costs (electric and cooking gas), and TV cable. NO SMOKING. Pets on a case by case basis.
